summary: Start v0.8.0 Shared Capabilities & Context Economics with deterministic token profiling, release growth warnings, and a lazily routed context-optimizer skill.

candidates.rationale: Add deterministic on-demand repository/context token estimation, Git-ref comparison, skill/file/root breakdown, and Python symbol profiling with executable tests.
Expose diagnostics through icm inspect tokens and classify the release-sensitive profiler for full regression without granting mutation authority.
Add 25% tracked-text and 15% orientation-context release warning thresholds plus an exact lazy review-skill route, validated fail-closed.
Add a small advisory skill for essentiality, functionality, redundancy, and context-locality review only when explicitly requested or a deterministic growth warning fires.
Document the routed context-optimizer skill without promoting it to default context.
Open the v0.8.0-dev development line and register the token-profiler entrypoint while retaining v0.7.0 as current stable release.

applied_changes.description: Added token profiler and focused regression tests.
Added inspect CLI dispatch, tool documentation, and impact-classifier integration.
Added validated release context-growth warning policy and lazy review-skill route.
Opened v0.8.0-dev metadata and README development identity.
